Lu-a-Jalla

Biography

Lu-a-Jalla is a young Joon and At-Zako’s beloved. On Ingos she is sought as the missing Princess. Diera imprisons her, believing her a rival for the governor’s affection, although Lu-a-Jalla says she loves only At-Zako. Zak brings her to Tka Rik and continues searching for her lover. Their reunion comes when Zak’s true identity is revealed, but the Joon Curse still threatens their future. [1, 2, 3, 4]
